name: ticker
description: A card of the in-game stock market: a symbol, the current value, the change over the visible history in green or red and a sparkline of it.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric traded on the card

config.name: label
config.label: Symbol
config.description: The name on the card, e.g. CPU. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: samples
config.label: History
config.description: The number of values in the sparkline. The change is measured from the first of them

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, values of 100 and more have none, smaller values one or two

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the value without its unit

config.name: hide_panel
config.label: Hide Panel
config.description: Hides the background of the card

config.name: up_color
config.label: Rising
config.description: The color of a rising value. Defaults to green

config.name: down_color
config.label: Falling
config.description: The color of a falling value. Defaults to red

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: The font of the texts. Defaults to Bahnschrift, which ships with Windows

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size of the symbol in pixels, the value is twice as large. If not set, it follows the height of the widget
